# Feature: Section role runtime tree (Header/Footer ownership)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-07 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Production Brevo HTML → Visual must place Header / Content / Footer / Social as distinct
`email-section` roots with correct `sectionRole` / `data-role` (and editable children).
No flattening into generic “Inhalt” sections; no CSS-only cosmetic fix; no parser rewrite.

## Preconditions

- Production fixture `packages/legacy-importer/fixtures/wrapped-production-brevo.html` available
- Editor + GrapesJS component registry loaded
- HTML → Visual uses `convertBrevoHtml` / `setComponents` (force convert path)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Normalized doc top-level roles: header, content×3, footer, social
- [ ] Mapper emits one `email-section` per section with nested row→column→blocks (no block flatMap to root)
- [ ] After `editor.setComponents(mapperOutput)`, runtime top-level roles match mapper
- [ ] Header contains exactly one brand logo image; not under content
- [ ] Footer: 1 row, 2 columns (logo+contact | cert); not under content
- [ ] Social: company-social under social section only
- [ ] Canvas/layer labels: Header / Inhalt|Bereich / Footer / Social Media from role
- [ ] ProjectData save/reload preserves sectionRole / data-role
- [ ] Visual → getHtml → re-parse isComponent restores roles (data-section-role or data-role)

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Missing sectionRole prop but data-role present still seeds model
- [ ] Legacy flat editorData not silently corrupted (migration only when needed)
- [ ] force convert does not re-wrap all components in a single content section

## Regression

- [ ] Starter template header/footer UX e2e still green
- [ ] Wrapped production importer unit tests green
- [ ] Build / typecheck green

## Assumptions

- Normalized recognition for wrapped-production is already correct; fix targets mapper props, Grapes model/isComponent, and any post-setComponents flattening
- Prefer `sectionRole` + serializable `data-role` (and `data-section-role` if needed for HTML roundtrip)

## Implementation Notes

- Files touched: `packages/legacy-importer/src/parser/parseEditorNativeHtml.ts` (new), `convert.ts`, `mapper/toGrapesJs.ts`, `document.ts`, `packages/email-components/src/layout.ts`, `register.ts`, `packages/editor-core/src/index.ts`, `apps/editor` TemplateEditorPage + e2e
- Root cause (J): Visual→HTML→Visual fed Grapes sibling `email-section` tables into Brevo `findEmailRoot`/`recognizeDocument`, collapsing ownership into one content section
- Fix: detect `data-email-type=email-section` and parse via native path; mapper sets `sectionRole` + `data-section-role`; `isComponent` restores role; wrapper droppable = sections only; labels `Inhalt`
- Unit tests: `editor-native-roundtrip.test.ts` + existing wrapped-production
- E2E: `section-role-runtime-dump.spec.ts`, updated `legacy-html-importer.spec.ts`
